name: Paladin
summary: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath. Paladins wear heavy armor, protect their allies with auras and healing, and turn spell slots into devastating smites.

hitPoints.Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d10 (or 6) + your Constitution modifier per paladin level after 1st

proficiencies.Skills: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion and Religion

spellcastingNotes: You prepare paladin spells after each long rest: half your paladin level (rounded down) + your Charisma modifier, minimum one.

classFeatures.name: Divine Sense
keyFacts: Action, 60 ft., until the end of your next turn.
Uses: 1 + CHA modifier per long rest.
classFeatures.summary: As an action, you know the location of any celestial, fiend or undead within 60 feet of you that is not behind total cover, until the end of your next turn. You also sense consecrated or desecrated places. You can use this 1 + CHA modifier times per long rest.
classFeatures.short: Action: sense celestials, fiends and undead within 60 ft.

classFeatures.name: Lay on Hands
keyFacts: Pool = 5 × paladin level, refills on a long rest.
Spend 5 points to cure a disease or poison.
classFeatures.summary: You have a pool of healing power equal to 5 × your paladin level, restored on a long rest. As an action, touch a creature to restore any number of hit points from the pool, or spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. It has no effect on undead and constructs.
classFeatures.short: Action: heal by touch from a pool of 5 × level HP.

classFeatures.name: Fighting Style
classFeatures.summary: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one option.

options.name: Defense
options.summary: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
options.summary: When you wield a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain +2 to damage rolls with it.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.summary: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a two-handed or versatile melee weapon held in two hands, you can reroll it once.

options.name: Protection
options.summary: Reaction while holding a shield: impose disadvantage on an attack against a creature within 5 ft. of you.

options.name: Blessed Warrior
options.summary: Learn two cleric cantrips; they count as paladin spells and use CHA.

options.name: Blind Fighting
options.summary: You have blindsight out to 10 feet.

options.name: Interception
options.summary: Reaction while holding a shield or weapon: reduce damage to a creature within 5 ft. by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus.

classFeatures.name: Spellcasting
keyFacts: Prepare paladin spells after each long rest: half your paladin level (rounded down) + CHA modifier, at least one.
Spell save DC = 8 + PB + CHA; spell attack = PB + CHA.
classFeatures.summary: You can cast paladin spells. Prepare paladin spells after each long rest: half your paladin level (rounded down) + CHA modifier, at least one. CHA is your spellcasting ability: spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + CHA modifier, spell attack = proficiency bonus + CHA modifier. You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus. You regain all spell slots on a long rest.

classFeatures.name: Divine Smite
keyFacts: 2d8 radiant for a 1st-level slot, +1d8 per level above (max 5d8).
classFeatures.summary: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can expend a spell slot to deal 2d8 extra radiant damage, plus 1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8). Add 1d8 against undead or fiends.
classFeatures.short: Spend a slot on a melee hit for big radiant damage.

grants.text: Divine Smite: on a melee weapon hit, spend a spell slot for 2d8 radiant (+1d8 per slot level above 1st, +1d8 vs undead/fiends, max 5d8).

classFeatures.name: Divine Health
classFeatures.summary: The divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

classFeatures.name: Sacred Oath
keyFacts: Subclass: oath spells and Channel Divinity.
classFeatures.summary: Swear the oath that binds you as a paladin forever. It grants oath spells, Channel Divinity options and features at 3rd, 7th, 15th and 20th level.

classFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
keyFacts: +2 to one ability or +1 to two, or a feat.
classFeatures.summary: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, 19th level, you can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't raise a score above 20 this way. If your DM allows feats, you can take a feat instead.
classFeatures.short: Raise one ability by 2, two by 1, or take a feat.

classFeatures.name: Extra Attack
classFeatures.summary: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
classFeatures.short: Attack twice with the Attack action.

classFeatures.name: Aura of Protection
keyFacts: +CHA modifier to saves for you and allies within 10 ft. (30 ft. at 18).
classFeatures.summary: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the save equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). You must be conscious. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.
classFeatures.short: You and nearby allies add your CHA to saving throws.

grants.text: Aura of Protection: you and allies within 10 ft. (30 ft. at 18th) add your CHA modifier (min +1) to saving throws.

classFeatures.name: Aura of Courage
classFeatures.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.
classFeatures.short: You and nearby allies can't be frightened.

classFeatures.name: Improved Divine Smite
keyFacts: +1d8 radiant on every melee weapon hit.
classFeatures.summary: Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage.

grants.text: Improved Divine Smite: +1d8 radiant on every melee weapon hit.

classFeatures.name: Cleansing Touch
keyFacts: Uses: CHA modifier per long rest.
classFeatures.summary: You can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch. You can use this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.
classFeatures.short: Action: end a spell on yourself or an ally.

journeyStages.label: Class
journeyStages.summary: Review the paladin at a glance.

journeyStages.label: Class Features
journeyStages.summary: What your class gives you, level by level.

highlights.title: Combat Role
highlights.body: Heavily armored frontliner who spikes damage with Divine Smite and keeps the party standing with Lay on Hands and auras.

highlights.title: Core Resources
highlights.body: Spell slots fuel both spells and smites. Lay on Hands is a healing pool of 5 × your level; Channel Divinity comes from your oath.

highlights.title: Level Rhythm
highlights.body: Fighting Style, spells and Divine Smite at 2, oath at 3, Extra Attack at 5, Aura of Protection at 6, Improved Divine Smite at 11.
